# Support

## Getting help

- **Bugs:** open an issue using the bug template. Include the language, the package version
  (`logquill --version` or your lock file) and a minimal reproduction.
- **Feature requests:** open an issue using the feature template.
- **Security problems:** do **not** open a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Start with the [documentation](../docs/README.md). The [architecture](../docs/architecture.md) page explains how the
pieces fit, and each binding's README (`bindings/<language>/README.md`) covers install and usage.

## Which versions get fixes

This matches the table in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

| Line | Status |
|---|---|
| 3.x, latest release | Supported |
| 2.x (Python, on `main`) | Supported while the 3.0 migration is in progress |
| 1.x and older | Not supported |

## What support means here

There is no service-level agreement. Reports are handled on a best-effort basis.

## Supported platforms

Per-binding runtime requirements (for example Python 3.10+ and Node 22+) are in each binding's README and are tested in CI.
